facts.fact_text: On 21 February 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
On 22 February 2003 two police officers went to the applicant's flat.
On 22 February 2003 two police officers took the applicant to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan.
At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 21 February 2003.

On 22 February 2003, several hours after being taken to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, the applicant was taken to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan (Երևան քաղաքի Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների առաջին ատյանի դատարան).
At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, the applicant was brought before Judge H.
Judge H. conducted a brief hearing in the applicant's case.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.
Judge H. found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration in Yerevan.
The applicant was taken to a detention facility following his sentencing.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.
At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 21 February 2003.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that the applicant, according to the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, was subjected to administrative detention for the violation of the prescribed rules for organising and holding assemblies, demonstrations, street marches and rallies.
